node: Data-center land, construction, EPC, permitting, water and local-regulatory capacity
summary: Expanded universe for the AI data-center site-control and execution-capacity node. The pass prioritizes US-listed companies with exposure to physical delivery constraints: site development, mechanical/electrical contracting, modular MEP execution, permitting/water/environmental engineering, and data-center real-estate/site-selection advisory. Core hypothesis: as AI buildouts move toward multi-hundred-megawatt and gigawatt-scale clusters, bottlenecks may shift from GPUs alone to entitled land, power access, water/discharge approvals, construction labor, utility coordination, and profitable conversion of backlog.
